kind.instructions: What kind of software task is this request?

criteria.feature: Add a new feature or behavior
criteria.bugfix: Fix incorrect behavior or an error
criteria.docs: Documentation, comments, or configuration text only
criteria.research: Investigate or compare options; no code change requested yet

size.instructions: How large is the expected code change?
criteria: Medium: several files in one area
Large: many files or multiple areas

research_needed.instructions: Does this task need external research (unfamiliar library, API, current versions or pricing, or comparing options) before implementation?

ambiguous.instructions: Is the request too ambiguous to implement correctly without asking the user a clarifying question?

design_contested.instructions: Are there several reasonable design approaches with real trade-offs, so that getting independent opinions before implementing would likely change the plan?
